text:
Ava: Quick thought — can we try rotating triage owners as paired shifts next week instead of single owners? saves context-switches and pairs can tag off.
Diego: I like that. Pairing could help knowledge transfer. How long are we thinking per slot? 2 hours or 3?
Priya: 2h feels tight given our bug churn on Mon mornings. Maybe 3h for the morning slot, 2h for afternoon?
Jonah: 3h morning + 2h afternoon seems reasonable. Also we should keep one backup on standby in case both folks get pulled into a hotfix.
Ava: Good call. Proposed schedule: Mon/Wed/Fri morning 9-12 pair A, afternoon 1-3 pair B. Tue/Thu swap. Backup on rotation each day.
Diego: Can we run this as a 2-week pilot and measure assigned-ticket closure and handoff notes count?
Priya: Yep — I'll add a tiny eval sheet. Fields: owner pair, slot, tickets triaged, followups created, time-to-ack.
Ava: Perfect. Also small agenda tweak for the weekly triage call: move "hotfix lane" to the top and limit deep discussion to 10 minutes, defer long ones to async thread.
Jonah: Agreed — add a quick dropdown for "needs design review" so we can route to the RFC channel after triage.
build-bot: Deploy reminder: triage-schedule.yaml updated in infra-config (deploy at 1854323000).
Ava: Action items: 1) Priya create pilot calendar invites + eval sheet, 2) Diego update rotation roster, 3) Jonah add design-routing tag to triage board.
Priya: I'll post the invites by EOD and ping owners. tagging @here for awareness :loudspeaker:
Diego: I'll update the roster and add a short note in the handbook about backups.
Jonah: I'll add the triage board dropdown and a tiny automation to create a followup task.
Ava: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the 2-week pilot and share metrics. :thumbsup:
Priya: If anyone wants to opt out of specific days (vacation/conflicts) drop a note here or update the roster spreadsheet.
Diego: Small ask — can we keep the triage thread pinned during the pilot so it's easier to find?
Ava: Yep, I'll pin it.
Jonah: One more — if the pair gets paged twice in <15m, fallback to dedicated oncall. We should document that in the playbook.
Ava: Noted, will add to playbook.
Priya: Done — calendar invites sent and pinned. Pilot starts next Monday.
Diego: :rocket:
